name: Revolution Beauty Group plc
summary: Revolution Beauty Group plc operates within the dynamic beauty and personal care industry. The company offers a diverse range of cosmetics, skincare treatments, and haircare items, distributed under a portfolio of various brands. Its sales channels encompass its own e-commerce platforms, complemented by wholesale relationships with both physical retail stores and digital vendors. Revolution Beauty boasts a substantial global footprint, with its products available in approximately 15,000 retail outlets across major chains in the United Kingdom, the United States, and numerous international markets. Founded in 2014, the firm is headquartered in Queenborough, United Kingdom.
